CVE-2026-90001.vulnerabilityName: BorderGuard SSL VPN Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (Lab Scenario)
CVE-2026-90001.shortDescription: MCCoE training scenario: unauthenticated remote code execution in an internet-exposed SSL VPN appliance allows full device compromise and lateral movement into the management zone.
CVE-2026-90001.requiredAction: Apply vendor hotfix BG-2026.06 or disconnect the appliance from the internet until patched. Restrict VPN portal access to managed jump hosts only and enable MFA for all remote access paths.
CVE-2026-90001.notes: MCCoE lab-only CVE for mitigation workflow training. Demonstrates KEV-style required actions without live exploitation.

CVE-2026-90002.vulnerabilityName: ADCS Misconfigured Template Domain Escalation (Lab Scenario)
CVE-2026-90002.shortDescription: MCCoE training scenario: misconfigured ADCS certificate templates permit low-privileged users to request certificates that enable domain administrator impersonation.
CVE-2026-90002.requiredAction: Audit and harden ADCS templates per ESC1/ESC8 guidance. Remove enrollment rights for non-administrative principals, enable manager approval, and monitor for suspicious certificate requests.
CVE-2026-90002.notes: Lab scenario aligned with Certified Pre-Owned attack paths. Use for privilege-escalation mitigation drills.

CVE-2026-90003.shortDescription: MCCoE training scenario: Jenkins script console reachable without authentication on a build server allows arbitrary Groovy execution and credential theft from pipeline secrets.
CVE-2026-90003.requiredAction: Disable script console for anonymous users, enforce SSO with role-based access, rotate all pipeline credentials, and move build infrastructure behind private network segments.

CVE-2026-90004.shortDescription: MCCoE training scenario: outdated Apache Tomcat manager interface exposed to the internet with weak credentials enables WAR deployment and remote code execution.
CVE-2026-90004.requiredAction: Upgrade Tomcat to the latest supported release, remove public manager endpoints, enforce strong credentials, and restrict administrative interfaces to management VLANs.
CVE-2026-90004.notes: Use for firmware/software update and network segmentation recommendations.

CVE-2026-90005.shortDescription: MCCoE training scenario: network management platform exposes SNMP v2c with default community strings, enabling configuration read/write and device manipulation.
CVE-2026-90005.requiredAction: Change default SNMP communities, migrate to SNMPv3 with authentication and encryption, update firmware on affected appliances, and block UDP/161 from untrusted networks at the firewall.
CVE-2026-90005.notes: Highlights firewall rules and firmware update mitigation steps.
